description: C code implementing backend APIs and data structures for IP interface management in a Broadband/Networking device firmware.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_GetEntryCount(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Returns the number of IPv6 prefix entries for a given interface.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE IPv6Prefix_GetEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ULONG nIndex,ULONG * pInsNumber)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPv6 prefix entry by index.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_IsUpdated(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Checks whether the IPv6 prefix table is updated based on the refresh interval.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_Synchronize(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Synchronizes the IPv6 prefix table with the backend data source.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE IPv6Prefix_AddEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ULONG * pInsNumber)
methods.description: Adds a new IPv6 prefix entry to the interface.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_DelEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ANSC_HANDLE hInstance)
methods.description: Deletes an existing IPv6 prefix entry.

methods.description: Retrieves boolean parameters such as Enable, OnLink, Autonomous for an IPv6 prefix.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves integer parameters. Not supported for current implementation.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG parameters such as Status and PrefixStatus.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters such as Alias, Prefix, ParentPrefix, and Lifetime fields.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_SetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL bValue)
methods.description: Sets boolean parameters such as Enable, OnLink, Autonomous for static prefixes.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_SetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int iValue)
methods.description: Sets integer parameters. Not supported for current implementation.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_SetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG uValue)
methods.description: Sets ULONG parameters such as Status and PrefixStatus.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets string parameters such as Alias, Prefix, ParentPrefix, and Lifetime fields.

methods.name: BOOL IPv6Prefix_Validate(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * pReturnParamName,ULONG * puLength)
methods.description: Validates the prefix data before committing; checks for duplicate aliases and prefix formats.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_Commit(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Commits the updated prefix data to the backend, either adding or setting.

methods.name: ULONG IPv6Prefix_Rollback(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Reverts the prefix data to the last known good state.
